headline_seed: Google Translate now lets you practice pronunciation
description_seed: The feature is rolling out in the U.S. and India with support for English, Spanish, and Hindi.

what: Google Translate now lets you practice pronunciation

clean_source_blocks.text: Pronunciation practice in Translate is getting started with support for English, Spanish, and Hindi, and is available in the US and India. Hopefully we’ll see it expand to a lot more languages down the road, but that’s all Google’s sharing for now.

Google Translate is celebrating its 20th birthday, marking the occasion with something users have been requesting for a long time. Google is introducing pronunciation practice, which is now available on Android for English, Spanish, and Hindi in the US and India. No word yet on when it will expand to other regions or arrive on iOS.

The result bears some resemblance to pronunciation features on Duolingo’s language learning app. Google Translate pronunciation practice is available for Android users in the US and India starting today in English, Spanish and Hindi. Google hasn’t announced if or when it will be expanded to other regions or made available for iOS users.
